# Security

Report a security concern through [Linkence Support](https://linkence.ai/support).

Include the Linkence Desktop version, Windows version, a concise description and reproducible steps when available.

Do not include passwords, session tokens, API keys, private workspace URLs, customer data or private application content in a public report.

For information about Linkence security controls, visit [Security at Linkence](https://linkence.ai/security).
